output.sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs), 2) AS gross_margin_eur FROM marts.fct_order_lines l JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue = true AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY gross_margin_eur DESC LIMIT 3;
output.explanation: Gross margin is computed at line level as net_amount minus cogs, for completed orders only (is_revenue = true), with order_date in 2025. Lines are joined to fct_orders for status and date and to dim_products for the product name. The result is grouped by product, sorted by margin descending, and limited to the top three. Margin is rounded to 2 decimals. The query was not executed, so the figures are unverified.
